sources.title: Palantir Technologies (PLTR) Signed A Poland Defense Software Agreement
sources.snippet: Palantir Technologies (NasdaqGS:PLTR) agreed to supply its Maven Smart System software to Poland's Ministry of National Defence for battlefield analysis. The Maven Smart System is intended to support real time operational insight and decision-making for Polish armed forces during combat situations.
